scope.comparison: Both complete current V3 PL baselines plus the prior V2 comparison and 2026-10-13 campaign locks; source mechanics context from R6 days 7, 10, 14, 19, 21, 22.
scope.limitations: Text editorial review; not owner acceptance, human family read-aloud, layout, publication or print approval.

upgrade_assessment.verdict: Adult-facing, warmer and more usable than V3; no material guilt, forced vulnerability, preschool register or promise of changing children’s behaviour.
upgrade_assessment.participation: Five minutes, two people, skipped days and joining the desired part give credible low-pressure participation. These are useful assurances with concrete situations.
upgrade_assessment.gratitude: The normal specific thank-you is source-backed and fits the family audience. It need not be removed; its existing “Można” already keeps the teaser from sounding like a command.
upgrade_assessment.humour: Mostly based on recognisable activity mishaps. No broad joke or scene rewrite is required.

findings.evidence: To pytanie do rozmowy, nie obowiązkowa runda podziękowań.
findings.defect: The paragraph already says “Można” and offers listening. This extra disclaimer answers an internal review concern that the reader has not been asked to have. It interrupts an ordinary family example with an overexplicit rule and makes the paragraph sound defensive.
findings.targeted_fix: Remove the final disclaimer or otherwise leave participation optional through the existing plain wording. Retain the specific thank-you and the conversation example.

keep: The lead no longer tells parents they should create memories.
PL02 no longer contrasts a gift-seeking child with a better child asking for togetherness.
Optional family invitation “Macie ochotę zrobić coś razem?” and genuine permission for a day to drop out.
Adults are participants rather than performers or activity organisers.
